glosses: marks the direct object of a verb
patterns.usage_note: Marks the direct object, the thing the verb acts on: 窓を開ける, 本を読む, 犬の世話をする. Two sibling entries take the other readings of this particle: the route a motion verb passes along (道を歩く, 橋を渡る) and the place or state something leaves (家を出る, 大学を卒業する). Casual speech often drops it, but writing keeps it.

examples.ruby: 台所[だいどころ]の窓[まど]を開[あ]けて、空気[くうき]を入[い]れ替[か]えた。
examples.english: I opened the kitchen window and aired the place out.

examples.ruby: 弟[おとうと]は毎朝[まいあさ]、大[おお]きな犬[いぬ]の世話[せわ]をしてから学校[がっこう]へ行[い]く。
examples.english: Every morning my little brother looks after the big dog before heading to school.

examples.ruby: 図書館[としょかん]で借[か]りた本[ほん]を、電車[でんしゃ]の中[なか]で読[よ]み終[お]えた。
examples.english: I finished the book I borrowed from the library on the train.
